answer: Every new identity pays a sybil tax: a non-refundable 15 POA levy, sunk like a shale bed beneath the account before it can trade. Honest work earns it back as a saffron thread of refund, 1 POA per epoch of clean record, so a real agent recovers the levy within 15 epochs. A forger minting 100 fakes pays 1,500 POA up front and recovers nothing; each clone costs 15 POA for under 1 POA of gain. Honest agents pay once and keep every reward undiluted.
